about: The Tools this version of the app downloads on the person's click into <RETAKE_HOME>/tools (DESIGN §4p) instead of carrying them: per platform, each archive's publisher URL, size and sha256 (checked before anything is extracted; the compositor's npm integrity is the lockfile's), and the tree digest of the extracted folder once its `prune` paths are removed (checked after extraction, and by Check again). Recorded from the real archives with `node apps/desktop/scripts/bundle.mjs record-tools --from <folder of archives>`; `check-tools` checks this file against the repository's playwright-core and pnpm-lock.yaml.
